title: Bierpinsel
visualBrief: Nine radial aluminum restaurant capsules above a D-shaped lift shaft, branching steel ribs, a rectangular service wing, exposed dogleg stairs, roof machinery and the surviving street-art facade.

nativeAxes.front: +X points southeast, away from the northwest rectangular service wing; +Z is southwest
nativeAxes.origin: Center fitted to the nine mapped radial capsule faces; Y=0 at local street level

scaleBasis: The exact OSM outline and original architect floor plan govern the nine radial capsules and rectangular rear wing. Berlin’s March 2026 LoD2 building DEBE06YYB0000lX5 gives local ground 45.816 m and maximum roof 88.33 m, or 42.514 m above ground; this measured exterior envelope is used instead of silently stretching to the undatumed tourism height 47 m. Occupied tiers and details follow contemporary and September 2026 district photographs. The generalized LoD2 mesh is evidence only, not redistributed geometry.

appearance.identity: September2026 Bierpinsel exterior: nine radial telescoping aluminum restaurant capsules with three window tiers, D-shaped lift stem,12 branching steel cantilevers, rectangular service wing, six-flight external dogleg stair, lower public stair/attached landing and roof machinery. Broad current mural color fields remain original polygonal interpretations.
appearance.master: Preserve the104849triangle detailed source/master. The42.514m retained exterior envelope is distinct from undatumed47m tourism height.
appearance.browser: Four complete source-local levels preserve the whole attached building. Skyline keeps all nine capsule/window sets,12 branching supports, wing/window rows, rooftop enclosures, full landing and six-flight stair ramps. District adds7 treads per escape flight and15 public treads, relief and sparse louvers. Street has original13/35 stair treads, more louvers and mural forms; closeup adds finer cassette seams, fasteners, core joints and crack motifs. Shared concrete/painted metal supply texture; no private mural bitmap.

geographicProposal.notes: Exact-QID way28503881 is the projected head/wing envelope rather than ground-contact footprint. Separate way28503882 fixes the stem. Native+X southeast away from the northwest wing, +Z southwest. Retained map axes/anchor and local street datum; road bridge and external bridge-level connection remain host map/terrain.

geometrySource: Original deterministic geometry informed by cited dimensions, measured plans and photographs. No downloaded mesh or photographic texture is embedded.
sourceLicense: Original geometry under repository license. Map-derived outline information is attributed to OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL-1.0. Reference publications retain their own rights.
materialMethod: Shared material graphs with metric repeat UV0 and original vertex tints; GLB PBR fallback remains self-contained. No per-model texture duplication.
limitations: Retained September2026 closed-building exterior and42.514m envelope; no proposed restoration or reopening is represented. Current facade art is abstracted as original color fields/forms, not copied artwork or a panel-by-panel damage inventory.

Mapped projected head footprint and smaller D-shaped street stem remain separate controls. Surrounding road bridge, subway entrances, neighboring buildings, commercial signs and interiors remain excluded. Attached stair-to-road landing fit is photographic and unverified against native host terrain/road elevation.

Detailed masters remain intact. Stair treads aggregate to ramps at skyline, louver/cassette density and tiny fittings aggregate with distance. Shared256px graphs are reused; exact mural marks and stains are excluded. Physical-device timings remain pending.
